reviews.decision: Retain the shared-clock architecture, but correct two source locators in the ADR when next editing: it repeatedly calls page-object /Dur 'Table 160's /Dur'. The effective source puts /Dur in page-dictionary Table 31 (physical 121 / printed 106); Table 160 is the navigator dictionary.
